basic_profile.bio: A new student at UMass, juggling between freshman year coursework and a part-time job at the campus library. Passionate about old video games and loves analyzing movie plots, especially the obscure ones. Originally from the Midwest but adjusting to the East Coast life. Active mostly in the evenings after classes and work. Single and enjoying the college life with new friends from various student clubs.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Recently graduated high school with a strong interest in film studies and game design. Developed a love for 'Under the Silver Lake' style movies through a high school film club and self-taught in retro gaming through online forums and YouTube.
